αὐγῇ: αὐγή — light, radiance, sunlight; fem. dat. sg.
αὖλιν: αὖλις — place to spend the night, lodging; fem. acc. sg., epic (no ordinary Attic equivalent)
βάλλε: βάλλω — throw, cast; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβαλλε)
δώσουσ: δίδωμι — give; fut. 3 pl., elided (δώσουσ’ = δώσουσι(ν))
κάρτος: κράτος (epic κάρτος, metathesis) — strength, might; neut. nom./acc. sg.; often acc. of respect: ’in strength’
καλοῖς: καλός — beautiful, fine; neut. dat. pl.
κανέοισιν: κάνεον — basket; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
καταλέξω: καταλέγω — recount in full and in order; fut. 1 sg. or aor. subj. 1 sg. (the epic forms coincide): ’I will tell in full’
κηρόθι: κῆρ — heart; with the suffix -θι of place: ’in the heart’, adv.
κρεῖον: κρείων — ruler, lord, ruling; masc. voc. sg., a title of address
μεγαλήτορα: μεγαλήτωρ — great-spirited, great-hearted; masc. acc. sg. (of Odysseus) · also of θυμός, ’great-hearted’ (μεγαλήτορα θυμόν) · also of Laertes, masc. acc. sg. (Λαέρτην μεγαλήτορα)
μετόπισθ: μετόπισθε — afterward, thereafter, hereafter; adv., elided (μετόπισθ’ = μετόπισθε)
νεῖμεν: νέμω — distribute, deal out; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, with movable ν (= ἔνειμε)
νεῦσ: νεύω — nod, make a sign; aor. 3 sg., elided (νεῦσ’ = νεῦσε), unaugmented (= ἔνευσε)
πλησάμενος: πίμπλημι — fill; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., ’having filled (for himself)’
στορέσας: στόρνυμι — spread, strew; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg.
τίει: τίω — honour, hold in honour; pres. 3 sg. (long ι; = Attic τιμᾷ)
τεθαλυῖαν: θάλλω — bloom, thrive, swell; perf. part. fem. acc. sg. ’thriving, flourishing’ (masc. τεθηλώς)
τελέσειε: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish, fulfil; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a wish with μή: ’may he not bring to pass’ · also in a wish after αἲ γάρ: ’would that he might fulfil’
τοίχου: τοῖχος — wall (of a house or room); masc. gen. sg.
τραπέζῃ: τράπεζα — table; fem. dat. sg., epic -ῃ (Ionic η for α), locative: ’at table’ · also dat. sg. with περιρρηδής: ’over the table’ (περιρρηδὴς … τραπέζῃ)
φθίσθαι: φθίνω — perish, waste away; aor. inf. mid.: ’to have perished’
φράζευ: φράζω — mid. think out, devise, plan; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -ευ (= Attic -ου): ’devise! plan!’
χαῖρ: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (χαῖρ’ = χαῖρε): ’rejoiced’
ἀλοιφῇ: ἀλοιφή — ointment, anything smeared on (fat, oil); fem. dat. sg., instrumental
ἀρᾶται: ἀράομαι — pray, wish; pres. 3 sg. mid., + inf.: ’prays that’
ἄκος: ἄκος — remedy, cure; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἐκάη: καίω — burn; aor. pass. 3 sg., augmented (unaugmented κάη), in tmesis with κατά (κατὰ … ἐκάη = κατεκάη): ’was burned up, were burned up’ · also without preverb: ’burned’ (νεκρός τ’ ἐκάη ’the corpse burned’)
ἐλεοῖσιν: ἐλεός — a board or table on which meat was set (exact object uncertain); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἐπένειμε: ἐπινέμω — deal out to, distribute (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’dealt out’
ἐφύπερθε: ἐφύπερθε — over the top, above, on top of; adv.
ἔνεικαν: φέρω — bring; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἤνεγκαν): ’they brought’
ἷζεν: ἵζω — sit, sit down; impf. 3 sg.
ὀψέ: ὀψέ — late, at a late hour; adv.
